english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Fifteen Paths; and whether the Catechumen would have avoided causing his Wealth to go on the Three Paths to Gehenna
english_classification.chapter_note: Heavily institutional chapter. The only substrate is the cosmological teaching about the fifteen paths in the zone (¶2-4), which the elect recaps as background to an institutional question about catechumen soteriology. The recapped teaching — fifteen paths (4 pure/8 mixed/3 waste), the three waste paths enumerated, and the cosmic law that persons follow their deeds — is genuine substrate cosmology (zone architecture, ships, light-waste separation, Cross of Light). Everything from ¶5 onward is institutional ecclesiology: how apostles pre-choose forms of their church, the seal of faith protecting catechumens, fasting/prayer purifying pre-conversion deeds, and an extended analogy about deeds traveling at different speeds. Gardner notes Buddhist karmic influence, thoroughly integrated into Manichaean institutional framework. Teaching purity 0.289 confirms institutional dominance.
